game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the innkeeper must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the cases value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about cases to power up the innkeeper and open the ice mill.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sled Run'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Sled Run.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
